title: Knowledge of God
definition: The knowledge of God is His perfect understanding of Himself, creation, history, hearts, and all reality.
summary: God knows all things truly, fully, and without error.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the Father's knowledge and gives His people true knowledge of God through Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's knowledge is infinite and perfect. He does not guess, learn by trial, forget, misunderstand, or discover what He did not know. All reality is open before Him.

God also gives true knowledge of Himself. Though humans cannot comprehend God exhaustively, they can know Him truly because He reveals Himself through Scripture and Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often confuse limited human perspective with final truth. The knowledge of God matters because it humbles pride and gives confidence that God sees what we cannot.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Trust God's knowledge above your own. Seek to know Him through Scripture, and bring your confusion to the One who understands all things perfectly.
